name: CheckboxIndicatorPrimitive
description: Check mark shown inside the checkbox while it is checked, or a dash while `indeterminate` is set. Renders a `<span>` element.

props.name: children
props.description: Icon shown in place of the default check mark or dash, such as an icon component. The element receives a `width` and `height` of `100%`. Anything other than a single element is ignored and the default icon is shown.

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class applied to the element, or a function that returns a class based on the component’s state.

props.name: keepMounted
props.description: Whether to keep the element in the DOM when the checkbox is not checked.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the element, or a function that returns a style object based on the component’s state.

props.name: render
props.detailedType: ReactElement | ((props: HTMLProps, state: Checkbox.IndicatorPrimitive.State) => ReactElement) | undefined
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.
